scoreNote: Strong-adequate (4.5): a two-view response holding that both wide travel and deep roots build connection; two developed examples with analysis, controlled prose on a memorable First and Second skeleton.

sentences.text: Some people connect easily with strangers, while others form deep bonds at home.
Some believe that travelling to many places increases our ability to connect with others, while others believe this comes better from living deeply in one community.
I believe both can build our ability to connect, in different but equally valuable ways.

sections.role: Body 1 — How wide travel builds connection

sentences.text: First, travelling to and living in many places can widen our ability to connect.
Meeting people from many cultures teaches us to understand very different ways of life.
For example, a traveller learns to find common ground with strangers of every background.
This shows that variety can make a person more open and adaptable with others.
Seeing how differently people live can also deepen our patience and our sympathy.
Those who have lived in many places often connect easily wherever they go.
To this extent, travel genuinely strengthens our bond with others.

sections.role: Body 2 — How deep roots build connection

sentences.text: Second, however, living deeply in one place builds a different and equally rich connection.
Staying in one community lets us know people slowly, over many years.
Consider a person who, by remaining in one town, builds lifelong friendships of great depth.
Such bonds show that real connection can come from time and shared history, not only variety.
Knowing one community deeply teaches loyalty, trust, and a strong sense of belonging.
Constant travel can leave relationships shallow, while deep roots make them lasting.
Both ways, then, can build a true ability to connect with people.
In conclusion, travelling widely can teach us to connect with many kinds of people.
But living deeply in one place builds bonds of equal value through time and trust.
Our ability to connect can grow both by seeing many places and by knowing one place well.
